openQuestions.text: Buccar's join point: Ch 1 in one timing source; the path guide calls it unclear and has him defect on Turn 1 of the Ch 9 battle. If he's missing before Ch 9, Jasmine stands in from Ch 6
Buccar's Beginner class: the path guide suggests Gladiator or Ornius Rider; the plan uses Soldier for the armored line
Elegant Drink Recipes: only the review source (from Game8) describes it (Ch 10, Renown 10, Wonder Leaves from Ch 11); the path guide doesn't list it. Placed in Ch 11
Does Simple Drink Recipes lead into Elegant Drink Recipes? Unconfirmed
Great Dancer's Successor deadline: 10/15 in the subquest guide, "may be 10/15 (unverified)" in the path guide
Dance for Raivo Port and Dance for Zoste end 9/1 per one read of the source (unverified)
The 10/15 Perform batch: one read of the source counted six quests, not three (Mons, Alecto, Barsh Post Town)
Pepper and Bitter Leaves at Traveler's Garden, past Port of Pandora, and the Drink Recipe chain order: single source (fortunesweave.online, community)
Dietrich's paralogue pickup window: 10/22 per the paralogue guide, 10/29 per the walkthrough. Pick it up by 10/22
Subquest deadlines before their chapter opens on Leda's calendar: The Fabled Insect Pearl 3/7, Can't Go Home 10/15, Can't Stay Home and Gisco's Treasure 10/24. Subquests are semi-random
Caladrius: Game8 says only Cai's path unlocks it; Game8, GameRant and TheGamer say unlocks carry over. No Leda unit uses it either way
Regroup: the video notes tie it to Pugilist; Game8's class data gives it to Brigand. The plan follows the class data. Its trigger (your miss or the foe's) is unverified
Io's horse: Rocinan is "Io's mount" in the growth tables, but no source says when he has it on Leda's path. He is a filler here; it only matters if he fills a Part II slot
Buccar's Armored Move +2: only the class video mentions it, and its Mov 7 doesn't add up from Armored Knight's Mov 4. Check his skill list
Catania's White Magic isn't a preferred skill, so C comes slowly; her learnset has Physic at B and Warp at A (GameFAQs: the only unit with both)
Mini Bow chest: the Hard-mode video puts one in a chest in one of Leda's first quests; the weapon video says Ch 3, but the path guide lists no Ch 3 chests. Open every chest early

Not documented: Fianna's White Magic list (Physic?), what class manuals and the Tactics Manuals (Nowah's Cave Lv 10, Corroios Fort Ruins Lv 13) add, each Ch 6 to 9 recruit's class on joining, the Ch 9 join level (Lv 15 or 25), when the Kothar Gar lakes and the desert open
Mastery speed: no source gives the Class EXP a mastery needs (one GameFAQs player: much quicker than Three Houses, a comparison). Every side trip ends on a condition
Part II carry rule: the game says "equipped"; the plan reads it as the 6 held items. Do stored Licenses reach Part II?
Deployment slots (about 6, 8, then 9) and Part II's 15-unit cap are player reports (one source each)
Perform Quests: no source describes a stat check, minigame or second unit
Dance or Song each turn, never both, and the Blaze Gauge rules: one source each (AllThings.How, community)
Does spell weight (Banshee 23, Luna 20, Death 13) count toward AS? Unconfirmed
Archive Γ in Vandahl Dagsion from about Ch 10: cost unknown. Archive T needs Pongo, with no Pongo source on this route
Supports: no source records which units have support conversations with her, combat bonuses from Support, or whether Theater shows and campfire meals raise Support
Ch 7 battle: the source has Maria summoning units, which may belong to the Ch 9 map
Shadowy Cave may stay locked on Leda's path until Dietrich's paralogue (Ch 11)
Buccar's starting class: one site lists him as a Lv 1 Commoner; no other source names it
Olympia's starting class: Diviner per one Fextralife snippet (unverified)
Catania's recruit: RPG Site lists her as automatic on Leda's route; one timing source notes Renown 2 for the tutorial
Yukito for the Vandahl Healing Staffs (Catania Ch 7, Fianna Ch 11) has no gather spot on this route: shops or crates?
Arena seats: the roster plan has five courses, each once a week with two seats; older notes say one session a week. The plan follows five courses
Dragonbone Tangle (Nysiades, Lv 20) is in the Ch 7 dungeon list, but the desert may only open on the Ch 9 Baina trip. Sha Lan's Hexlock comes from it either way
